Tell me in about 200 words why people in India are switching to UPI, with a short list of 3 reasons
2:51 AM

People in India are switching to UPI because paying someone is as easy as sending a text, and it costs almost nothing. Launched in 2016, it now handles billions of payments every month, from chai stalls to rent and school fees.

Three main reasons:

Speed and simplicity: Scan a QR code or type a phone number, enter your PIN, and the money moves between banks in seconds. No card machine, no cash, no hunting for change.
Low cost: For most people and small shops there are no charges. A shopkeeper only needs a printed QR code, which is why even street vendors joined in.
One system, many apps: You can pay anyone from any bank through PhonePe, Google Pay, Paytm or your bank's own app. Nobody is locked into one company, which built trust and made it easy to start.

A few other things helped. Cheap smartphones and data brought it within reach, and the 2016 note ban nudged people to try digital payments. Once friends and shops all used it, sticking with cash became the harder choice.

One tip: never share your PIN, and never approve a payment request you don't recognise.

2:51 AM

Plan a 3 day trip to Jaipur for my parents
2:54 AM

Here's a relaxed 3-day Jaipur plan for your parents, with a private car and driver so there's little walking and no rushing.

Day 1, Forts and old city: Amer Fort early while it's cool (take the jeep up instead of climbing), a photo stop at Jal Mahal, then Hawa Mahal and a slow stroll through Bapu Bazaar in the evening.
Day 2, Palaces and culture: City Palace and Jantar Mantar in the morning, a long lunch break, then Albert Hall Museum. Finish with dinner at Chokhi Dhani for Rajasthani food and folk music.
Day 3, Temples and shopping: Govind Dev Ji Temple, Birla Mandir, and Galta Ji if they're up for it. Leave the afternoon free for block-print fabrics, jewellery and Rajasthani sweets.

Late October to November is pleasant weather in Jaipur, but it's also busy, so book hotels and Amer Fort jeeps early. Choose a hotel near the old city to cut travel time.

Which dates are they going, and from which city? I can then check the details for you.
